findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_research_articles, get_article, get_ai_citation_sources, list_race_explorers · Public sink: search_research_articles, get_chain_vs_independent_mix · Destructive: get_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_research_articles, get_article, get_ai_citation_sources, list_race_explorers · Public sink: search_research_articles, get_chain_vs_independent_mix · Destructive: get_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
